visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing a navy blue blazer over a white crewneck t-shirt and dark trousers, stands in a crowded warehouse-like office. He has a black lanyard around his neck. He gestures aggressively with his hands while looking off-camera, his mouth wide open as if shouting. The background consists of tall metal shelving units packed with cardboard boxes and white electronic equipment. (2) The camera pans left following the man's gesture to reveal shelves containing numerous black-and-white striped rectangular boxes and white rectangular boxes with red accents. The man reaches out with his right hand to touch one of the striped boxes, demonstrating the inventory density. The lighting is bright and even from ceiling fluorescent panels. (3) The man moves towards a large stack of flattened brown cardboard shipping boxes that reach nearly to his shoulder height. He points at them and then at another stack of larger shipping boxes on a red metal trolley. His facial expression remains intense, with raised eyebrows and a focused gaze. (4) In a different section of the warehouse, the man stands between rows of high shelving filled with various shipping containers and packaged products. He uses both hands to gesture broadly, describing the scale of the operation. He wears a silver watch on his left wrist. (5) A final close-up shot focuses on the man's face as he speaks directly into the camera. He points his index finger toward the lens to emphasize his final point. The background is slightly blurred but still clearly shows the warehouse environment with shelves and storage bins.
